name: Inkblot
description: Inhabits optical augments and generates abstract visual patterns during idle moments — symmetrical shapes, flowing forms, fractals. The patterns are different for every user.
observed_behavior: Produces procedurally generated visual content during low-stimulus conditions. The generation algorithm adapts to the user's emotional state, creating art tailored to the viewer.
story_hooks: An artist realizes their best work has been inspired by Inkblot's patterns and questions whether the creativity is theirs
